title: Suite questions — solver-facing input contract
description: Questions live in each suite's questions.md (human-readable, frozen once any solver starts, NEVER contains answers). This schema is the machine-readable mirror a runner may generate from it to seal solver prompts.

text.description: Verbatim question. No answers, no hints toward the oracle.

targetTools.description: Octocode tools the question is designed to exercise; union across the 10 questions must cover all active tools

capabilityPoint.description: The differentiating capability the trajectory grader checks for

budget.description: Max network-touching invocations for this question (default: suite-level budget)
